Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of UNH.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.77 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 10% to 17% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2023.
Our cloud segment grew 10% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $5.2 billion this quarter, representing 10% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 196 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
